note: Mongolia: foreign nationals working on employment visas need work permits under the Labour Migration Law in force from 1 July 2022, applied for by the employer and granted for up to a year. No performers' exemption was found, so no days. Read from an accounting firm's alert, since the official translation's host refuses this client.

sources.title: PwC Mongolia, Tax alert No. 03/2022: Labour Migration Law effective from 01 July 2022
sources.said: Foreign nationals who work in Mongolia with employment visas are required to obtain work permits
